evidence.title: 3,900+ Free & Pro Shadcn Blocks | Shadcn UI Blocks

name: Shadcn UI Blocks
summary: Catalog of 3,913 shadcn/ui blocks plus templates, 99 Open Graph image templates, a page Designer and a hosted MCP server.
description: A catalog of shadcn/ui blocks in three tiers: premium Modern SaaS (89), standard Marketing, Ecommerce, Application and Portfolio (3,198) and free (626), plus 6,000+ community blocks from 105 public shadcn registries. It adds two Next.js site templates (Keel, Primely), 99 Open Graph image templates (PNG, SVG, source), a drag-and-drop page Designer and a hosted MCP server that lets an assistant search and install blocks; the site now lives at shadcn-ui-blocks.com. Every block is a self-contained shadcn registry item; free blocks install without credentials, premium ones need a Pro or Team key.
contains: 10 collections: Modern SaaS, Marketing, Ecommerce, Application, Portfolio, Components and more
4,002 shadcn registry items; install by URL or @shadcn-ui-blocks/ name with the shadcn CLI
6,000+ community blocks from 105 public shadcn registries
2 Next.js templates (Keel $99, Primely $79) and 99 Open Graph image templates
hosted MCP server: search_blocks, get_block, list_collections, get_designer_file
page Designer with multi-page files, light/dark previews and shared team files
pricing: free tier, Pro $15/mo, Team $20 per seat/mo
